records.title: Fast algorithm for quantum polar decomposition, pretty-good measurements, and the Procrustes problem
records.evidence_read: Lemma1, Algorithm2, Theorem3 and its proof, including subnormalization.
records.mechanism: Polar transformation from state-preparation block encodings.
records.reduction: Preparation access does not eliminate spectral scale.
records.no_go_barrier: Runtime explicitly depends on inverse smallest singular value and ensemble size.
records.open_question: An independently costed native normalization escape.
records.reusable_abstraction: Track actual projected operator, not just its condition-number ratio.
records.scope: Local different-projector circuit is not identified with the paper's ordinary block; no improvement claim.

records.title: Quantum algorithm for Petz recovery channels and pretty good measurements
records.evidence_read: PGM section, Eq21 and state-access requirements.
records.mechanism: Petz recovery specialized to state discrimination.
records.reduction: Runtime depends on ensemble access and spectral parameters.
records.no_go_barrier: A compact purification is not a free inverse density operator.
records.reusable_abstraction: Charge preparation, inverse scale and output environment.

records.title: Bernstein- and Markov-type inequalities for rational functions
records.evidence_read: Page2 Eq1.1 recalling the standard polynomial Bernstein derivative inequality; rational extensions not applied.
records.mechanism: Bounded polynomial slope grows at most linearly with degree away from endpoints.
records.reduction: Integrate from zero for odd scalar/vector spectral polynomials.
records.no_go_barrier: Local application only; arbitrary rational algorithms not bounded by this polynomial degree statement.
records.open_question: A costed representation outside the scoped polynomial filter.
records.reusable_abstraction: Do not confuse endpoint Markov bounds with interior Bernstein bounds.
